title.ja: Security Knowledge — 事故から点検へ
title.en: Security Knowledge — From incidents to checks

coverage.ja: 2025-10-02〜2026-10-02の公表日を対象に23事例を追加し、過去の10事例と合わせた選定DBです。評価試験・複数組織の攻撃報告も含むため、件数は企業数や事故全体の統計を意味しません。
coverage.en: A curated database with 23 records disclosed during 2025-10-02–2026-10-02 and 10 earlier records. Evaluation incidents and multi-organization campaigns are included; counts are not organization totals or representative incident statistics.
